pr.title: feat(governance): add devops autopr operating model
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds the governance-first AutoPR operating model, authority ledger, tool routing, health matrix, PR acceptance rules, PR Steward v1 design scaffold, embedded audit policy, and research/drift ledgers.
- Adds runbooks and prompts for GPT-5.5 supervisor/packet forge/acceptance reviewer, Codex and Claude Code implementers, AGY/Claude/Gemini auditors, and PR Steward summaries.
- Adds JSON schemas for embedded audit and PR Steward check-only outputs.
- Adds generated packet records for this governance slice and the next PR Steward implementation slice.

## Scope
Governance/docs/schemas/prompts/task-packet/proof only. No runtime GitHub mutation, auto-fix, review-thread resolution, auto-merge, merge queue mutation, secret storage, or dependency changes.

## Validation
Run JSON parse checks, task-packet schema checks, git diff --check, required grep coverage, git status, and diff stat. Embedded audit is required.

## NOT_RUN
Runtime PR Steward implementation, live GitHub PR mutation, auto-fix, auto-merge, merge queue mutation, and broad test suite unless runtime code is touched.

## Residual Risks
AGY model selection must not be guessed if local help does not prove it. PR Steward remains design/schema/task-packet scaffolding until TP-DMX-PR-STEWARD-001 is executed.

steps.task: Preflight repo identity, branch identity, schema path, authority files, local workflow conventions, and local tool availability.
commands: find docs task-packets prompts schemas proof tools scripts tests runbooks -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | head -300
validation: Branch identity is explicit before edits.
Canonical task-packet schema path is observed or missing schema is reported.
Local auditor flags are not guessed.

steps.task: Create operating model docs and runbooks for the one-supervisor, one-implementer, one-embedded-auditor flow and PR Steward review-intake gate.
validation: Docs preserve authority boundaries and do not claim runtime PR Steward behavior.
Docs include skip-second-GPT-5.5 and escalation rules.

steps.task: Create prompt pack for supervisor, implementers, auditors, and PR Steward summary.
validation: Prompts require repo identity checks, diff/stat capture, command outputs, exit codes, embedded audit when required, PR Steward readiness if a PR exists, and no second GPT-5.5 review when gates are READY.

steps.task: Create JSON schemas for embedded audit and PR Steward check-only outputs.
validation: All schemas parse with python -m json.tool.
PR Steward schemas include all required dispositions and mutation_performed=false.

steps.task: Create generated packet records and additive task-packet template sections.
validation: Generated packet records parse as JSON and validate against the canonical dopetask schema.

steps.task: Run embedded audit, write proof, run final validation, inspect diff scope, and commit only if gates pass.
validation: Embedded audit is PASS or non-blocking PASS_WITH_RISKS before READY can be claimed.
PROOF.json parses and records command outputs, exit codes, git state, validation state, embedded audit, UNKNOWNs, and blockers.
git diff --check passes and diff remains inside allowlist.
